observable: The status of the EUR 9.9bn earmark in German federal budget documents after September 2024.
indicator: Budget line and off-budget vehicle reporting; supplementary budget documents
confirm_if: The earmark is de-committed, reallocated, or allowed to lapse without being re-offered to a successor investor
disconfirm_if: The EUR 9.9bn is re-offered intact to an alternative investor for the same site
counter_indicator: A new German chip subsidy package of comparable size for a different site
